requirements.evidence: Migrations match the spec: entities slug unique('entities_slug_unique') + softDeletes (create_entities_table.php:17-19); memberships FKs cascadeOnDelete, role default 'employee', storedAs "CASE WHEN role = 'owner' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END" and unique indexes 'entity_memberships_entity_user_unique' / 'entity_memberships_one_owner' (create_entity_memberships_table.php:16-35). Contract present: Entity getRouteKeyName/memberships/users/owner (Entity.php:51-81), EntityMembership cast + #[Scope] owner/admin/employee (EntityMembership.php:112-160), UserRole::manageable (UserRole.php:231-234), User::memberships/entities/membershipFor (User.php:182-205), factories with states, both policies with the required bool methods. Policy logic matches rules, including never deleting the owner membership and self-removal (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:271-282).

conventions.evidence: Policies in app/Policies, deliberate #[Fillable] on both models (Entity.php:42, EntityMembership.php:101) in sibling User style, reversible down() in both migrations, docs/database-schema.md, docs/README.md and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] updated. Small deviation: an existing CHANGELOG 'Changed' entry was rewritten (CHANGELOG.md:17-18) instead of only adding a new line, and 'locale_default' was dropped from the planned entities diagram (docs/database-schema.md:577) though it was not part of this design change.

security.evidence: Every policy method is deny-by-default for non-members via membershipFor()?->role null check (EntityPolicy.php:353-358, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:287-292); strict in_array on enum; mass assignment restricted by #[Fillable]. Minor gap: assignRole (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:263-266) lets an admin target the owner's membership, so a later action relying only on this policy could let an admin demote the owner; the task does not explicitly forbid it.

tests.evidence: Three Pest feature files cover factories, route key, relations, owner()->first() null case, scopes, DB default role, index names, slug/membership uniqueness, second-owner rejection, multiple owners across entities, cascade and soft deletes (EntityModelTest.php), plus allow/deny matrices for every policy method including non-members and members of other entities and Gate discovery (EntityPolicyTest.php, EntityMembershipPolicyTest.php).

simplicity.evidence: Lean models and policies relying on native Eloquent features (generated column, HasOne with where, #[Scope]). Small duplication: near-identical private helpers hasRole (EntityPolicy.php:353) and hasEntityRole (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:287).

readability.evidence: Clear names, one-line PHPDoc on every public method, short focused methods, explanatory comment on the owner_seq trick (create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-23); no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: No routes, session, middleware or UI added; all code serves the task. Minor extra edits: rewording a past CHANGELOG entry (CHANGELOG.md:17-18) and removing the planned entities.locale_default column from the diagram (docs/database-schema.md:577).

issues.explanation: assignRole allows an admin to target the owner's membership, so a future role-change action relying only on this policy could let an admin demote the owner.
The planned entities.locale_default column is removed from the diagram although only owner_membership_id was meant to be replaced, dropping documentation for a future (out-of-scope) locale feature.
An existing changelog entry is rewritten instead of only adding new lines under [Unreleased].
The role-check helper is duplicated almost verbatim in EntityMembershipPolicy::hasEntityRole.

review.summary: The change adds the entities and entity_memberships migrations with a portable generated-column single-owner constraint, the Entity/EntityMembership models, the UserRole enum, factories, both policies and the docs updates, all matching the contract and backed by thorough Pest tests. Only small issues remain: an admin can target the owner membership in assignRole, there are minor doc/changelog edits beyond what was needed, and the policy helper is duplicated. Approve with nits.
